name: Jade Cloud
change: Milky clouds inside the glass in a few soft patches, like the clouds in nephrite jade, with a trace of grain.
good: Closest to jade: soft milky clouds inside the glass, with a trace of grain, that appear in a few places and fade out.
watch: The most visible of the five; stronger, its clouds would read as smoke.

name: Marble Vein
change: Soft, faint mineral veins that wander through a few patches and fade out, like marble.
good: The clearest sign of stone for the least change: a few soft veins wander through and fade out.
watch: The sparsest: some panels show no vein at all, and a curled vein can read as a stray mark.

name: Honed Grain
change: A fine stone grain of light and dark flecks, as on honed granite, in patches.
good: Reads most as cut stone: a fine grain of light and dark flecks in patches, like honed granite.
watch: The busiest up close; behind small text its flecks can look like grit.

name: Speckled Jade
change: Sparse dark flecks of different sizes in a faint haze, like the mineral specks in natural jade.
good: The quietest: sparse dark flecks of different sizes in a faint haze, like the mineral specks in natural jade.
watch: Faint at a glance, and the flecks could be mistaken for dust on the glass.

name: Mottled Slab
change: Small lighter and darker mottles with a trace of grain, like serpentine or soapstone, in broad patches.
good: Soft lighter and darker mottling with a trace of grain, like serpentine: stone-like and still quiet behind text.
watch: Its lighter mottles can read as clouds rather than stone at a glance.
